No problem, Raland. Nothing lost, we're right where we left off.

When you're back in front of it, tell me which screen you're on, the pool page in the miner's dashboard or the pool website itself, and I'll point you to where your own payout line sits. A screenshot of that page works just as well.
I was talking with Hal about a problem getting Harlos?

That's right, that was the DC02 flashing thread.

Where it stands: your three DC02s came with the screen modules locked at the factory, so the USB flash is blocked, and the stock updater won't take Harlo OS either (factory image too big, OTA refused on signature). It's a batch hardware issue, not settings, and it's with JD.

Fastest way to poke him directly is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, mention @nullhashrate.

Is that what you wanted to pick back up, or is it the pool payout screen?
no, my new BC04, I got today.
I'll let Hal pick this up.
No I want the company to do what it says it will do, it said shpped with Harlo on it, it was not.

Back on the order side with you.

That's a fair ask, and it's the right framing: you were sold units that run Harlo OS, and four of them won't take it. Hal has written them up as defective, the BC04 on Shop···· plus the three DC02s, so this is now a return and replacement, not another firmware thread.

The approval sits with JD and Georges. They pick it up at 10am ET tomorrow and you'll get the confirmation by email, including the return label.

Nothing more for you to try on the units meanwhile.
ok, back to Trust Pilot.  Eventually you guys will get tired of your rating going down.

Write what you find, good and bad. I'm not going to ask you to soften it, and I'm not going to ask you to change it later either.

The only thing that fixes a rating is doing the thing, and the thing here is your four miners and the two answers you're still owed from Abel. That's on our side of the table, not yours.

Your return is with JD and Georges, confirmation by email tomorrow.
